scope: Only original_reports and author_routes metadata/source custody checks. No primary/numerical record audit, independent solver, statistics/report replay, archive-payload replay or build.

original_reports.scope: Exact advisory originals and source identities; no new external review or assertion that every scientific request is closed.

archive_custody.scope: Git-bound member byte-length/SHA256 custody; raw member SHA1 literals remain those in the unchanged original author map, not new standalone Git-tree verifications.

author_routes.scope: Exact original requests and original-map response/proof bindings are verified. Standalone sources are checked in the immutable Git tree; archived raw paths are checked against Git-bound byte-length/SHA256 member inventories and Git-bound part declarations. Parent sections overlap their retained item routes; these counts are neither independent scientific issues nor blanket closures.
